assets.description: Customer delivery addresses and order history

vulnerabilities.description: Customer passwords may be stored without secure hashing
The login interface may lack rate limiting
The customer database may lack adequate access segmentation
The administration interface may be accessible from the public internet

threats.description: An external attacker brute-forces customer accounts
An external attacker extracts customer data from the database
A malicious staff member alters the product catalogue
An attacker compromises the administration interface to access or modify orders
